text.p: Following are some of the leading stories in Norwegian papers this morning:
-Scandinavian Airlines System (SAS) is no longer among the most punctual European airline companies. Statistics show that one plane in every six is delayed.
-Police raided motorcycle gang clubs on Thursday in search of weapons used in the latest shooting incident. The six largest clubs in Norway have a total of 84 members.

-Shipbuliding and engineering group Kvaerner appears to have won the race for Aasgarb B contract ahead of its main offshore rival Aker Maritime. The seven billion crown contract is for a semi-submersible gas platform.
-Shipyard Kaarboe has won a contract to build 40 trawlers for Russian company Anpo Aquapolis.

-There are great Norwegian interests at stake when EU issues new directives for gas this spring. Liberation of the European gas market could make it almost impossible for Norway to sign long-term supply agreements.
